name: DuckDB CQRS Phase 0
description: Create the pure review-serving contracts, registries, cursor and admission helpers, SQL-shape guards, diagnostics, and benchmark smoke harness without changing product route behavior.

userStories.title: Define review-serving core contracts
userStories.description: As a developer, I want shared review-serving contract types so later Phase 0 modules can agree on freshness, counts, search, bulk, snapshots, workload classes, and route budgets.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update `src/server/reviewServing/reviewServingContracts.ts` with explicit freshness states, count/search/bulk states, named fast count keys, workload classes, route budget shapes, snapshot identifiers, required/optional component states, and physical filter access strategy types.
Keep contract definitions pure and free of database calls or route behavior changes.
Use `effect` for any non-trivial JavaScript/TypeScript async or server flow added by this story, while keeping pure transforms as plain functions.
Add adjacent tests for contract invariants and exported state values.
`bun test src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bunx eslint src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Build projection identity helpers
userStories.description: As a developer, I want stable projection identity helpers so review-serving rows can carry only the invalidation keys they depend on.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update `src/server/reviewServing/reviewProjectionIdentity.ts` with stable identity builders for display, search, judgment-input content, project scope, prompt config, review config, and composed route identities.
Identity builders produce stable output for equivalent input ordering and do not include unrelated projection inputs.
Keep helpers pure and free of database calls or route behavior changes.
Use `effect` for any non-trivial JavaScript/TypeScript async or server flow added by this story, while keeping pure transforms as plain functions.
Add adjacent tests proving stable identity hashing and narrow component dependencies.
`bun test src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bunx eslint src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Add invalidation registry
userStories.description: As a developer, I want every planned review-serving delta kind mapped to the narrowest affected component so later write paths cannot fall back to broad project invalidation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update `src/server/reviewServing/reviewServingInvalidationRegistry.ts` with every Phase 0 change kind planned for Phase 2 and Phase 3.
Each change kind declares first affected component, downstream dependents, required affected keys, and update mode.
LLM judgment changes do not invalidate display, selected-import, or search components unless those inputs actually changed.
Unknown change kinds are not treated as broad project invalidation.
Use `effect` for any non-trivial JavaScript/TypeScript async or server flow added by this story, while keeping pure transforms as plain functions.
Static tests prove every `reviewServingChangeKind` has an invalidation registry entry and no unknown change kind becomes broad project invalidation.
`bun test src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bunx eslint src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Create read contract registry
userStories.description: As a developer, I want every planned hot review read registered with serving-table, cursor, budget, count, filter, freshness, and workload metadata before route migration starts.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update `src/server/reviewServing/reviewServingReadContracts.ts` with contract entries for LLM, human, both, unassessed, filter, facet, badge, count, row, queue, detail, health, warning, prompt preview, bulk, PDF, export, and search surfaces planned for Phase 4.

Every contract declares workload class, cursor spec, result budgets, allowed filters, physical filter access strategy, named fast counts, freshness behavior, required/optional components, and physical serving table.
Read contracts point only to planned serving/index tables and do not include raw fallback tables.
The migration inventory maps contracts to product routes without changing route behavior.
Use `effect` for any non-trivial JavaScript/TypeScript async or server flow added by this story, while keeping pure transforms as plain functions.

Static tests prove every `reviewServingReadContracts.ts` key has workload class, cursor spec, budgets, allowed filters, physical filter access strategy, named fast counts, freshness behavior, and required/optional components.
`bun test src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bunx eslint src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Add cursor and filter signature helpers
userStories.description: As a developer, I want review-serving cursors and filter signatures to be snapshot, projection identity, filter, and sort scoped so migrated routes can reject stale or mismatched cursors.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update `src/server/reviewServing/reviewServingCursor.ts` with cursor encode/decode helpers and validation against snapshot ID, projection identities, component state, filter signature, sort key, and route contract.
Add stable filter signature helpers that produce identical signatures for equivalent filter inputs.
Malformed cursors and identity, component, filter, or sort mismatches return explicit invalid-cursor results instead of raw fallback behavior.
Keep helpers pure and free of database calls or route behavior changes.
Use `effect` for any non-trivial JavaScript/TypeScript async or server flow added by this story, while keeping pure transforms as plain functions.
Add adjacent tests for cursor round trips, malformed cursors, filter signature stability, and mismatch rejection.
`bun test src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bunx eslint src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Add admission interfaces and diagnostics shape
userStories.description: As a developer, I want registry-based admission and diagnostics contracts so Phase 4 foreground work can be admitted or rejected before DuckDB execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update `src/server/reviewServing/reviewServingAdmission.ts` with registry-based admission for registered contracts, page/result budgets, stale allowance, unsupported count shapes, and synchronous substring search rejection.
Admission returns explicit accepted or rejected results without executing DuckDB SQL.
Add diagnostics shapes for freshness, count/search/job state, route budget decisions, workload class, and rejection reasons.
Do not add product-specific SQL or route behavior changes.
Use `effect` for any non-trivial JavaScript/TypeScript async or server flow added by this story, while keeping pure transforms as plain functions.
Add adjacent tests for accepted registered work, unregistered foreground work, over-budget work, stale snapshot behavior, unsupported counts, and synchronous substring search rejection.
`bun test src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bunx eslint src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Add serving SQL-shape guards
userStories.description: As a developer, I want SQL-shape guard helpers so new review-serving SQL cannot accidentally reintroduce raw fallback, unbounded scans, or large-offset pagination patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/server/reviewServing/reviewServingSql.ts` or sibling `reviewServingSql/` files with SQL-shape guard helpers for new serving SQL builders.

SQL-shape guards reject `selected_scoped_article_import`, `ROW_NUMBER(`, `OFFSET`, raw `app.article` scans, raw `app.judgment` scans, `json_extract`, and unbounded foreground `GROUP BY` in new serving SQL.
SQL-shape guards accept bounded serving-table keyset SQL over registered serving/index tables.
Static guards protect the new `reviewServing` package and do not fail just because legacy routes still delegate to OLAP before Phase 4.
Use `effect` for any non-trivial JavaScript/TypeScript async or server flow added by this story, while keeping pure transforms as plain functions.
SQL-shape tests prove new serving SQL cannot include raw fallback shapes.
`bun test src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bunx eslint src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Add benchmark smoke harness scaffold
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a smoke-capable benchmark scaffold so later phases can run the full 10M-article/7-prompt overlap workload with consistent metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a benchmark harness scaffold for the 10M-article/7-prompt synthetic fixture and overlap workload definition without requiring completed schema or projectors.
The harness metrics shape includes p50/p95/p99 latency, memory, temp usage, queue depth, rows scanned, rows returned, and admitted/rejected work.
The smoke path can run against minimal or mocked inputs before final schema/projectors exist.
The full 10M benchmark remains documented as a Phase 5 release gate and is not required for Phase 0 completion.
Use `effect` for non-trivial JavaScript/TypeScript async benchmark orchestration, resource lifetime, retries, polling, or backoff, while keeping pure transforms as plain functions.
Benchmark smoke harness can run without requiring completed schema/projectors.
`bun test src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bunx eslint src/server/reviewServing` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
